# has stream

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasStream`](gmeow-hasStream.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasStream>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/observations`](../../slices/observations.md)

Links an entity to a stream of observations or samples about it. Non-functional: an entity may have multiple co-existing streams from different platforms or sensors ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)), and no stream is privileged.
